name: Biomerics LLC
reason: Biomerics is primarily a medical device contract manufacturer (CDMO). Per the strict rules, contract manufacturers are a DROP regardless of adjacent custom material compounding divisions.

name: Amcor plc
reason: Excluded as a medical packaging film converter and finished packaging solution maker; they are a downstream customer rather than a raw material polymer supplier.

name: Berry Global Inc.
reason: Excluded as a downstream film converter/laminator making finished medical device packaging; they do not supply the raw medical-grade polymers.

name: Klöckner Pentaplast Group
reason: Excluded as a plastic film converter and processor making rigid/flexible packaging films; they act as a downstream customer of medical polymers.

name: Tekni-Plex, Inc.
reason: Excluded because they are a converter and healthcare packaging component manufacturer rather than a base polymer supplier.

name: Wipak Oy
reason: Excluded as a downstream multi-layer film converter and finished medical packaging developer.

name: Renolit SE
reason: Excluded as a technical film processor/converter that transforms plastic granules into medical fluid bags and sheets; they do not supply the core medical polymer material.

name: PolyCine GmbH
reason: Excluded because their primary business is extrusion/conversion of non-PVC films and tubes for pharmaceutical solutions, acting as a consumer of medical polymers.

name: Glenroy Inc.
reason: Excluded as a flexible packaging converter and laminator of high-barrier films for medical devices.

name: UFlex Limited
reason: Excluded as a flexible packaging manufacturer, converter, and laminator producing multi-layer composite barrier films and packaging solutions.

name: Smith & Nephew plc
reason: Medical device manufacturer and downstream consumer of medical films for wound dressings, rather than a raw polymer/material supplier for medical films.

name: Sealed Air Corporation
reason: Manufactures packaging films and finished protective materials rather than the core raw polymer and medical-grade base film materials defined by the market scope.

name: Shandong Weigao Group Medical Polymer Co., Ltd.
reason: A medical device manufacturer that produces finished medical consumables and devices (infusion sets, bags), acting as a customer/converter rather than a core material supplier.

name: Nova Flexipack Pvt. Ltd.
reason: A film converter and flexible packaging manufacturer creating finished packaging pouches/webs rather than a raw medical polymer film material supplier.

name: Bemis Company, Inc.
reason: Acquired by Amcor plc in 2019 and absorbed; no longer operates or trades under its own independent corporate name.

name: Sealed Air Corporation
reason: Duplicate entry. Focuses on finished packaging systems and coextruded protective substrates rather than core base polymer resin film materials.

name: Hypac Packaging Pte Ltd
reason: Downstream packaging converter providing sterile pouches and thermoformed bottom webs rather than supplying raw medical film polymers.

name: FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation
reason: Manufactures radiographic diagnostic imaging dry/laser films. The market scope explicitly isolates suppliers of raw medical-grade polymers and material layers (like TPU, PE, PP, polyester substrate layers) for films, while excluding downstream finished medical imaging/X-ray films.

name: Agfa-Gevaert Group
reason: Manufactures finished medical diagnostic imaging/radiography X-ray films rather than supplying the core medical-grade polymer material types (TPU, PP, PE, base polyester films) specified by the boundary rules.

name: Hangzhou Kenid Medical Instruments Co., Ltd.
reason: A downstream manufacturer of medical dry thermal and laser imaging printing X-ray films, which falls under the excluded category of finished medical-device consumables instead of basic polymer film materials.

name: Hebei Hsin Film Technology Co., Ltd.
reason: Manufactures downstream hospital radiology consumables like finished medical inkjet and thermal dry X-ray imaging films, which does not match the target definition of raw material polymer/base film suppliers.

name: Achilles Corporation
reason: Manufactures technical plastic films (predominantly anti-static, flame-retardant PVC curtains/sheets for cleanrooms and factories) and urethane foams, but lack of evidence establishing them as a supplier of target medical-grade polymer films like TPU or packaging films for dressings/drapes requires a DROP.
